thread:
maria: Quick sync — I opened a docs PR to update streaming + pagination snippets across Py/TS/Go to use the new cursor resume API. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482. Need review + tiny copy edits before merge.

jon: thanks! can you list the specific snippets touched? I want to run them locally.

maria: python: examples/stream_resume.py, examples/paginate_async.py; ts: samples/streamCursor.ts; go: cmd/stream_resume/main.go. Also updated the README example for `client.generate` usage.

lee: I'll run the Python snippets against the harness. heads up: the py snippet uses `for chunk in client.stream(...)` which we switched to `.stream_text(...)` in SDK v0.13 — might need a direct edit.

maria: good catch — updated snippet to `.stream_text` in latest commit (force-pushed).

sam: For TS, note we should keep the async iterator example for Node 18 compat. I left a comment: `// For older Node, use the async iterator fallback` to avoid breaking examples.

maria: also adjusted retry semantics in samples: added a tiny exponential backoff example. Example added inline:
```python
# simple retry (docs-friendly)
for attempt in range(3):
    try:
        resp = client.generate(..., timeout=30)
        break
    except RetryableError:
        time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
```
Can we standardize to our retry util or keep inline snippet?

tim: we do have a retry util at devex/retries.py — importing it in docs is awkward. I'd prefer an inline minimal snippet with a comment linking the util for advanced users.

lee: ran the harness on the updated py snippets — whitespace/f-string nit fixed. All green except the Go example panics on EOF when streaming short inputs.

sam: Go fix idea: switch incremental read loop to check for io.EOF vs io.ErrUnexpectedEOF and avoid ReadAll for streaming. I'll push a small patch.

maria: tagging @docbot for link checker after merge :docbot: please run link-check on /docs/sdk/snippets when ready.
